pricing_model_reference: DeepSeek Official Chat API Peak Conservative Pricing

estimated_cost_usd_from_usage.definition: Cost calculated strictly from actual token counts (prompt_cache_hit_tokens, prompt_cache_miss_tokens, completion_tokens) reported in API response usage metadata.

conservative_reserved_cost_usd.definition: Upper-bound financial reservation committed prior to dispatching an HTTP request, based on conservative byte-length input token upper bounds and max_tokens output at peak cache-miss pricing. Released upon receiving valid usage, or permanently reserved if request fails with unknown consumption.

audited_bill_usd.definition: Actual financial deduction verified against official DeepSeek billing management console / monthly invoice. Never conflated with runtime usage estimates.

policy_notice: 不得将按usage估算的金额直接等同于最终账单实扣金额。账单实扣需以官方控制台账单对账为准。
